svg.title: Patterns Are Tested in Practice
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: a stove with a pot on it, steam rising. One mannequin stands at the stove tasting from the pot with a spoon. A second mannequin stands nearby holding up a hatched recipe card and writing a correction on it with a pencil. The recipe card is a pattern, the focus. The stove and pot are practice: a real place where the pattern gets used. Cooking from the card and tasting the result is the first half of the solution: apply the pattern somewhere besides where it was written. Writing on the card is the second half: when the pattern doesn't fit what happens in practice, revise it and say why. The two figures are different people, so the test isn't only by the pattern's author. The metaphor: a pattern as a recipe, which proves itself only when it's cooked, and gets corrected in the margins.
